Name: NSFW Photos- Heart Album
Author: sweetinsanity9
Description:
[center]This mod adds photos to the photo album added by the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43247]Heart Album[/url]. Each heart level/level of friendship unlocks a new photo for each character which will be added to the album. Photo scenes are all lore friendly and NSFW.[/center]
[center]

[img width=300,height=300]https://user16162.na.imgto.link/public/20260705/installation-1.avif[/img]
Download the mod[color=#00ff00] [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43247][color=#00ff00][color=#00ff00]Heart Album[/color][/color][/url][color=#ffffff] [/color]from here on Nexus. 
Unzip my mod's folder and navigate to the folder [i][color=#00ffff]Mods\NcydeAlbumMod2\assets[/color][/i]
Copy and paste the pngs from my mod's folder into this folder and you're done!
Press [color=#ff00ff]F8[/color] once in game to open the album and view your photos. [/center]
[center]
[img width=231,height=231]https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1785062266283-037406c4-b13b-4cb6-b166-e244decb82bb.png[/img][/center]
[center]There is an [color=#ffff00][u]optional[/u][/color] download in this mod's download page to add photos for Sandy.[/center]
[center]Use any mod for now that adds the hearts system to her- [color=#00ff00](Stardew is about to update so she can be befriended/romanced inherently!)[/color][/center]
[center]Copy and paste the png files from the my mod's folder into the same folder as the main mod:  [i][color=#00ffff]Mods\NycdeAlbumMod2\Assets[/color][/i][/center]
[center]Same as before- open the album with [color=#ff00ff]F8[/color] to view your photos[/center]
